name: The Torch of Retribution
summary: At Kalaran Windblade's side, you wait while he joins the pieces and enchants The Torch of Retribution.

sections.title: Binding the Pieces
sections.body: Kalaran Windblade needs time to join the pieces and enchant the torch. He channels magic as he works, so you wait and leave him undisturbed.

sections.title: When the Wait Ends
sections.body: After a while, the torch appears before Kalaran, and he says the work is done. One final matter remains for you to see to.

faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade joins the pieces and enchants the torch. He channels magic to complete it.

faq.q: What came right before this step?
faq.answer: The Flame's Casing came just before this. You found a Symbol of Ragnaros for Kalaran to make into the casing.

faq.q: Why must you not interrupt Kalaran?
faq.answer: Kalaran is channeling magic as he joins the pieces. He warns you not to interrupt him.
